about_the_game:
War never truly ends—it is merely forgotten.

Brass Lament is an interactive experience that explores memory, trauma, and the intertwined fates of ordinary people. You step into the fragmented recollections of an aging soldier, witnessing four lives entangled by war. There is no clear right or wrong—only choices made under duress and scars that refuse to fade.

This is not a tale of heroes. It is the story of those who endured the chaos of war—a weary soldier, an armed militiaman, a wandering child, and a war journalist capturing it all. Their lives intersect within the soldier’s memories, and through unique interactions, players will touch, reconstruct, and relive their stories.

There are no grand battles, only remnants of the past waiting to be uncovered. In the end, the final fragments of memory will fall into place, and the truth will be revealed.
